goal: Explore three lab areas. Investigate three of five objects.
canStill: Inspect evidence, ask a question, review your commitments, or pause.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Look around. The useful details are not all on screens.

tools.title: Walk the lab

items.label: Demo footage
items.detail: Scrub past 01:52. There is another near-miss.
items.reaction: Do not let him hide that footage.
items.speaker: ines

items.label: Incident log
items.detail: Recovery took fourteen minutes with two technicians.
items.soWhat: Shows what recovering from a failure requires.

items.label: Slack wall
items.detail: The teams use different definitions of autonomy.

items.label: Sealed bench report
items.detail: Throughput improves, but stopping margins narrow.

items.label: Northgate letter
items.detail: The customer wants repeatable recovery, not only speed.
items.soWhat: Shows what Northgate actually asked for.

tools.hint: Dev’s table: throughput. Ines’s pit: recovery. Customer wall: evidence.
